daily.today_energy: Your vibe is grounded but curious today. There's a gentle pull toward trying something new while your natural Taurus stability keeps you anchored. Trust that restless feeling—it's asking you to grow.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your energy shift. Whether you're single or coupled, authenticity is your superpower right now. Stop overthinking and let your real self show. Vulnerability hits different today.
daily.career: Ideas are flowing but don't rush to act on all of them. Filter through what actually aligns with your goals. Your intuition about what's worth your time is unusually sharp—lean into that gut feeling.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance, not extremes. Movement that feels good (not punishing) is calling to you. Maybe it's a walk, dancing, or stretching. Listen to what brings ease, not just results.

weekly.overview: Mercury's vibes are shifting your communication game this week, Taurus. You're feeling more confident in expressing what's been on your mind. Trust the momentum—it's bringing clarity to situations that felt murky before.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering softly in your corner. Whether you're coupled up or single, this is about deepening connections with intention. Show up authentically; people are drawn to your grounded energy right now.
weekly.career: Your creative problem-solving skills are leveling up. This is the week to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or take initiative on a project. Your natural ability to see the practical path forward is your superpower.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for grounding practices this week. Lean into movement that feels nurturing—walks, stretching, anything that connects you to earth. Notice what brings you into your body and do more of that.
